subject: Run-of-Show Sprint + Audience Q&A Triage
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Michaels <ava@datasync.io>, Jasper Events <events@jasperevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Grace OConnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Run-of-Show Sprint + Audience Q&A Triage

Hi Ava / Jasper team —

Thanks again for agreeing to join the Aug 25 webinar with our product team. We want to run a short rehearsal and finalize the on-day Q&A triage so the live audience experience is clean and we surface the highest-value questions to the panel.

Proposed rehearsal windows (30–40 minutes each):
- Tue 8/17 9:00–9:40 PT
- Wed 8/18 11:00–11:40 PT
- Thu 8/19 3:00–3:40 PT (backup)

Goals for the rehearsal:
1) Quick mic check, slide handoff, and 3-minute product demo snippet for Ava to confirm flow.
2) Run Q&A triage matrix (who fields chat questions, which questions escalate to product engineering, timing for follow-ups).
3) Confirm on-day backup: who takes over if someone drops (AV/producer steps).

I've attached the latest run-of-show (run_of_show_v3.pdf) and Ava's headshot for the registration page. Please review and confirm which rehearsal window works best. If none of the above, tell me two alternative times and we'll iterate.

Quick note on format: we'll use Zoom (panelist mode), but we'll stage the session from Redwood's console for output. Stephanie will be the producer and will post the Zoom link.

Appreciate it — looking forward to finalizing.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Events & Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Run-of-Show Sprint + Audience Q&A Triage

Dylan — thanks for the clear plan and the run-of-show. 8/17 at 9:00 PT works for me.

A couple quick items from my side:
- For the demo snippet I’ll need a 3–4 slide deck (I can reuse what I presented at DataSync Connect) — can someone (Marissa?) share the slide template we should use?
- On Q&A triage: I want to make sure we capture post-webinar product questions that require follow-up (pricing, integrations). Would be helpful to map those to owner tags in the triage matrix.

Also — is there a preferred place you want us to drop speaker notes? I can add talking points to the Drive doc if that's easiest.

Look forward to the rehearsal.

—Ava

Subject: Re: Run-of-Show Sprint + Audience Q&A Triage

Thanks Ava — 8/17 9:00 PT is confirmed and I've scheduled a 40-minute rehearsal on the calendar. Zoom link and dial-in are below. I'll be the producer on the call and will record the rehearsal.

Zoom (producer): https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9123456789?pwd=example
Dial-in: +1 669 900 9128

I've also attached a starting Q&A triage matrix (q_and_a_triage_matrix.xlsx) and created a Drive folder for speaker notes. Please add any slide decks or speaker notes there: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-examplEdrive

Rehearsal agenda (20–40 min):
- 0:00–0:05 — Quick intros + timing overview
- 0:05–0:12 — Ava: demo snippet (3–4 slides)
- 0:12–0:20 — Panel + product Q&A flow (who answers what)
- 0:20–0:30 — AV checks, screen share practice, and slide handoff
- 0:30–0:35 — Contingency walkthrough (dropouts, muted mic)
- 0:35–0:40 — Confirm next steps and on-day roles

On Q&A ownership: proposed mapping in the matrix (high-level) —
- General product questions: Panel (Ava + Redwood PM)
- Pricing & contracts: Marissa (Sales) owns follow-up
- Integrations & engineering feasibility: Escalate to engineering@s-reply (we'll tag with "eng-followup")

Action items before rehearsal:
- Ava: drop demo slides into Drive (by 8/13 EOD)
- Marissa: confirm speaker slide template is the company template (Marissa to attach)
- Dylan: update run_of_show if there are flow tweaks (I'll take notes at rehearsal)

Attachments: [attachment: q_and_a_triage_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]

—Stephanie

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Run-of-Show Sprint + Audience Q&A Triage

All — quick update after reviewing rehearsal notes and the triage matrix. Rehearsal on 8/17 went smoothly; main changes I pushed into run_of_show_v3.pdf:
- Moved demo to start of segment (first 10 minutes) to anchor questions.
- Added explicit Slack channel for live ops (#events-webinar-aug25) and escalation path.
- On-day backup: if a panelist loses connection, Jasper Events producer will stage a standby recording and Grace will step in for the live moderation role.

Open items (please confirm by EOD 8/19):
- Marissa: please drop the speaker slide template into Drive and confirm that speaker bios match the registration copy.
- Ava: please upload your 3–4 demo slides by 8/13 (if you missed that deadline, please do asap).
- Stephanie: confirm you'll be on the producer bridge 45 minutes before showtime (we'll ask Jasper to do the same).

On escalation day-of: if AWS or streaming issues appear, flag in #events-webinar-aug25 and call the on-call infra number +1 650-555-0199. Marissa, I'm putting you as the primary for any pricing follow-ups.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — we're in good shape. I'll do one last pass on the run-of-show Friday morning and circulate the final PDF.

Best,
Dylan
Events & Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
